output.reason: [ev-b1e8ad65539c] is the general upgrade-guide procedure. It describes two ways to upgrade a bootstrapped Flux (regenerate the manifests and push them to Git, or rerun bootstrap). It does not name anything that changed in 2.7.0, and it does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated if the operator does nothing. "The controllers stay on the previous version" is just what happens when you don't upgrade, not a consequence of a change in this release. So migration-required claims mandatory work the evidence doesn't support, and since there is no release-specific change, no corrected assertion follows.
